dict.string: Camera access lets you take photos for your profile, landmarks, and travel diary. Photos stay on your device unless you choose to share them.
Location access lets Worldwanderer show your position on Apple Maps, create landmarks at your current location, and check off wish list places when you arrive.
Photo library access lets you choose photos for your profile, landmarks, and travel diary, and find places based on where your photos were taken. Your photos never leave your device.
